entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I always found the Porte Drazon Cit..."
entries.dialogueText: I always found the Porte Drazon Citadel as majestic as it was unnerving. With its long metal spires, the building emanated an aura of terrifying grandiosity.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just looking at it sent a shiver do..."
entries.dialogueText: Just looking at it sent a shiver down my spine.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In my study, a stack of papers were..."
entries.dialogueText: In my study, a stack of papers were waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A matter of life and death."
entries.dialogueText: A matter of life and death.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In that impenetrable prison, there..."
entries.dialogueText: In that impenetrable prison, there were people residing on my orders. I had to decide on their fates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I reviewed the papers once more."
entries.dialogueText: I reviewed the papers once more.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pressed my ring on the wax, seali..."
entries.dialogueText: I pressed my ring on the wax, sealing the order.
entries.menuText: Press your seal on the wax.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was done. The decision had been..."
entries.dialogueText: It was done. The decision had been made.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided not to execute anyone."
entries.dialogueText: I decided not to execute anyone.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to punish these prisoners..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to punish these prisoners by execution.
